# ReadoutLayerTraining

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of training only the output weights from reservoir states to target outputs, typically via linear regression. Simplifies learning in iNEST hardware, reducing training complexity and enabling fast, energy-efficient adaptation in-network.
